definitions.gloss: periodic medical checkup; regular health screening
definitions.explanation: A routine medical examination conducted at regular intervals to monitor health and detect problems early. Includes both general health checkups and specialized screenings.

examples.japanese: {年|ねん}に{一回|いっかい}{定期検診|ていきけんしん}を{受|う}けている。
examples.english: I get a regular checkup once a year.

examples.japanese: {定期検診|ていきけんしん}で{虫歯|むしば}が{見|み}つかった。
examples.english: A cavity was found during a regular checkup.

examples.japanese: {定期検診|ていきけんしん}のおかげで{病気|びょうき}を{早期|そうき}に{発見|はっけん}することができた。
examples.english: Thanks to regular checkups, the illness was detected early.

notes:
USAGE:
Applies to various types of regular medical examinations, including general health checkups ({健康|けんこう}{診断|しんだん}), dental checkups ({歯科|しか}{検診|けんしん}), and cancer screenings ({がん{検診|けんしん}}). In Japan, companies are legally required to provide annual health checkups for employees.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {定期検診|ていきけんしん}を{受|う}ける (to have a regular checkup)
- {歯科|しか}の{定期検診|ていきけんしん} (regular dental checkup)
- {定期検診|ていきけんしん}の{結果|けっか} (checkup results)

WORD FORMATION:
{定期|ていき} (regular, periodic) + {検診|けんしん} (medical examination).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {健康|けんこう}{診断|しんだん}: health checkup (often abbreviated to {健診|けんしん})
- {人間|にんげん}ドック: comprehensive physical exam (more thorough)
